canonical_data: an append-only markdown decision log of past ratings with later returns and reflections, per-ticker SQLite checkpoint databases for resumable runs, saved report folders and a Streamlit history, all under a user home directory
current_repo_note: A fork of TauricResearch/TradingAgents, whose own licence file and NOTICE it keeps, recorded in its change log against an upstream commit of 4 May 2026. It earns its own record under ADR 020 because its interfaces, data layer, analyst set and canonical data differ: it adds a Streamlit interface, PDF export, mainland-China data vendors, three market-specific analysts and a decision-performance report.
strengths: Runs are resumable: a per-ticker SQLite checkpoint keyed by ticker and date lets an interrupted analysis continue, and the decision log stores each rating so a later run fills in the realised return and alpha against the CSI 300
A quality gate checks each analyst report for minimum length and failure phrases before the debate starts, so a tool failure does not silently feed the decision
Its own performance command reports direction accuracy from the stored decisions and warns in the output when fewer than twenty are settled that the ratios are noise
weaknesses: The accuracy of its ratings is unvalidated; the readme frames the project as research and teaching and disclaims investment advice, and the performance report is explicitly not a backtest
Market data comes from unofficial public endpoints of financial sites and a TCP quote server, and the readme describes anti-ban handling for one of them, so the data layer can break without notice
It is a fork whose architecture is the upstream project's; the A-share specialisation is a prompt, data and rules layer maintained by one person
The default path sends every analysis through 30 to 50 calls to a hosted model, so running it costs API money or a subscription unless a local model is configured
why_it_matters: Shows what happens when a popular multi-agent research pipeline is localised to a different market: the debate structure stays, while the data vendors, trading rules and reporting layer have to be rebuilt.
